title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode4 A Way To Support

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Alright, now that I've bought souvenirs for Miku and the others, I should be good.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How is everyone... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, is everything okay? You look troubled.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani. Actually, I'm struggling to decide which souvenir to get.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a friend who tutors me on singing, but I'm not sure what to get for her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Does she also play in a band?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no. She's actually a PXL cast member.
She's an absolutely amazing singer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's taught me so much, so I'd really like to get her something nice...
The night of Leo/need's solo show
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
After that bath, I feel like I can finally relax.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We actually had our first solo show...
And yet, it doesn't feel like it's fully over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's calling me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi?
I wonder why she's calling me this late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello. Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Oh, hi... Sorry for calling this late.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's alright. I just got out of the bath and was about to have some barley tea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Hehe, I see. Make sure to keep warm.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Um, Hoshino... Congratulations on your first solo show. You sang so well.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <All of the things you and your bandmates wanted to convey really came through. So...I was really moved by your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad. It makes me so happy hearing that from you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also... I think you're part of the reason today went well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been helping me with my singing all this time, right? Thanks to that, I've been able to improve... And that's what kept me working hard for this solo show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. It's nothing.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <But hearing you sing...made me want to try harder too.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <The way you sang with such confidence up there today was so cool...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <It made me think, “Wow, my friend is amazing.” After that, I felt like I should be more brave.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <It made me want to work harder, so that I can stand on stage the same way you did.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Sorry for dumping all of that out of nowhere. That was weird.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not at all. Let's both keep working hard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
So you're hoping to find a gift for her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I was thinking of getting her something that can be a sign of my support...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something that can give her support...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how about something matching?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Something matching?
Like a keychain?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You know, I think a reminder that she's not alone would help her have courage whenever she's feeling anxious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A fan once told me how concert merch had that effect on them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Concert merch?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They said the matching merch they bought with their friend cheers them up because it reminds them of that shared memory.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... I think I can understand where they're coming from. Saki has said something similar before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I'll get her something we can have a pair of.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wonder what would be good...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This little blue bird...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I remember Kusanagi mentioning that the main character of this musical she recommended treasured something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That looks good. They would be cute as a pair.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too! I'll go with these little blue bird keychains.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kiritani. I'm glad I was able to pick something nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope your friend likes it.
Hey! It's Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: The girl wearing glasses?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: You're right! It's Haruka Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh oh, what should we do? At this rate, people are going to start gathering...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani, this way—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Haruka's coming this way! I'm gonna ask for an autograph!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: What? You don't even have anything she can write on! Let's just shake her hand!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. I see that you were able to see through my disguise. Well done.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: I could tell it was you straight away since you're so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. It makes me happy hearing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have a favor to ask all of you. Would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Really? What is it, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is... I'm actually in the middle of a game of hide and seek.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want anyone to know where I'm hiding, so... Could you all please keep my location a secret for me?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Okay, my lips are sealed!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: But as a trade, can I shake your hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, of course.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Me too, me too! Can I have an autograph?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line: Alright everyone, that's enough—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't have a pen or paper, so I won't be able to sign autographs...but if you wait quietly and patiently, I can take turns shaking your hands?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry about this, Hoshino. I know Tenma and the others will worry if we don't get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I know. Could you go ahead first? I'll meet up with you after this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Kiritani's amazing...
She's an idol even in a place like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I'll wait for you with the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, so who's first?
